questions.title: Is there a written Emergency Response Plan for the property, reviewed within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: CSA Z1600. Separate from, and consistent with, the Fire Safety Plan.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Review and update the Emergency Response Plan

questions.title: Does the plan cover the hazards identified for this site (e.g. power outage, flood, gas leak, severe weather, medical emergency, bomb threat, violent incident, hazardous spill)?
questions.instructions: Based on a site hazard and risk assessment.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Complete a site hazard assessment and add missing scenarios to the plan

questions.title: Are emergency roles (incident lead, wardens, first aiders, building operator) assigned, with alternates for each?
questions.instructions: Names and contact numbers in the plan.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Assign emergency roles and alternates; update the plan

questions.title: Is the plan available to building staff and tenant emergency contacts (printed copy on site and electronic copy)?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Distribute the current plan to staff and tenant contacts

questions.title: Have tenants’ own emergency procedures been collected and checked for consistency with the building plan?
questions.instructions: Especially for tenants with special hazards, large occupant loads or 24-hour operations.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Collect and review tenant emergency procedures

questions.title: Is the emergency contact list (fire, police, ambulance, utilities, elevator, restoration and alarm contractors, management) current, reviewed within the last 6 months?
questions.instructions: Post at the security or concierge desk and keep in the emergency kit.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Update and repost the emergency contact list

questions.title: Is the tenant emergency contact list current, including after-hours numbers?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Update tenant emergency and after-hours contacts

questions.title: Can occupants be notified of an emergency (voice paging, mass notification or another reliable method), and was it tested within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: Voice communication is part of the fire alarm in many high-rises (CAN/ULC-S524 / S536).

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Test or set up occupant notification and record the result

questions.title: Is there a documented escalation process for notifying senior management, ownership and insurers?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Document the incident escalation and notification process

questions.title: Are assembly points designated, marked and known to occupants, with a backup location?
questions.instructions: Away from the building, fire department access and traffic.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Designate, sign and communicate assembly points

questions.title: Is there a procedure to account for occupants after an evacuation (warden sweeps and reports)?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Add an occupant accountability procedure and brief wardens

questions.title: Is there a shelter-in-place procedure (for outdoor hazards such as chemical releases or severe weather), including how to shut down air handling?
questions.instructions: CSA Z1600.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Write a shelter-in-place procedure, including HVAC shutdown steps

questions.title: Are there procedures for occupants who need help to evacuate, with evacuation aids (e.g. evacuation chairs) available and staff trained?
questions.instructions: NFC 2.8.2. Answer N/A for single-storey buildings with level exits.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Provide evacuation aids and train staff in assisted evacuation

questions.title: Has an exercise of a non-fire scenario (e.g. tabletop, shelter-in-place or power outage) been held within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: Fire drills are covered in the Fire & Life Safety Inspection. CSA Z1600 exercise program.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Plan and hold an emergency exercise; record lessons learned

questions.title: Have building staff and the emergency team been trained on the Emergency Response Plan within the last 12 months?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Train staff and the emergency team on the plan

questions.title: Were tenants briefed on emergency procedures within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: E.g. an annual tenant emergency meeting or bulletin.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Hold or send an annual tenant emergency briefing

questions.title: Have corrective actions from the last exercise or real incident been completed?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Complete outstanding actions from the last exercise or incident

questions.title: Are first aid kits provided as required by provincial regulation, fully stocked and inspected?
questions.instructions: CSA Z1220 / provincial first aid regulations (e.g. Ontario Reg. 1101, Alberta OHS Code Part 11).

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Restock first aid kits and record the inspection

questions.title: Is a trained first aider available on site during operating hours, as required by provincial regulation?
questions.instructions: Keep training certificates on file.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Train or designate additional first aiders

questions.title: Is an AED on site, signed, accessible, checked monthly, with pads and battery within their expiry dates?
questions.instructions: Manufacturer instructions; register with local EMS where a program exists. Answer N/A if no AED.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Service the AED and replace expired pads or battery

questions.title: Where hazardous chemicals are used, are eyewash stations or showers provided, unobstructed and activated weekly?
questions.instructions: ANSI/ISEA Z358.1. Answer N/A if not required.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Install, repair or resume weekly testing of eyewash stations

questions.title: Are shut-offs for gas, water and electricity identified, labelled, accessible and shown on site plans?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Label utility shut-offs and add them to site plans

questions.title: Are written shutdown and restart procedures available for critical building systems?
questions.instructions: Kept with the building operator and in the emergency kit.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Write shutdown and restart procedures for critical systems

questions.title: Is there an elevator entrapment procedure, with the 24-hour elevator contractor number posted?
questions.instructions: CSA B44. Answer N/A if no elevators.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Post the elevator contractor number and write an entrapment procedure

questions.title: Is there a procedure for power outages, including which systems run on emergency power and how long?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Document the power outage procedure and emergency power loads

questions.title: Is there a water leak and flood procedure, with leak detection and sump pumps (if any) tested within the last 12 months?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Write a flood procedure and test sump pumps and leak detection

questions.title: Is there a severe weather procedure (snow and ice, high winds, extreme heat or cold, flooding), with weather alerts monitored?
questions.instructions: Environment and Climate Change Canada alerts.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Write a severe weather procedure and set up alert monitoring

questions.title: Are roofs, drains and catch basins inspected before winter and spring thaw?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Inspect roofs, drains and catch basins

questions.title: Where earthquakes are a risk, are earthquake procedures in place and heavy items secured?
questions.instructions: Mainly British Columbia and parts of Québec. Answer N/A elsewhere.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Add earthquake procedures and secure heavy items

questions.title: Is there a bomb threat procedure, with a call checklist at reception or security?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Add a bomb threat procedure and call checklist

questions.title: Is there a procedure for a violent incident (lockdown or hold-and-secure), communicated to staff and tenants?
questions.instructions: Coordinate with local police guidance.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Write and communicate a lockdown or hold-and-secure procedure

questions.title: Is there a procedure for suspicious packages and mail?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Add a suspicious package procedure

questions.title: Do access control and after-hours security procedures work as intended (doors secure, cards and keys controlled)?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Fix access control issues and update the key and card register

questions.title: Are spill kits available where fuels, oils or chemicals are stored or used, and fully stocked?
questions.instructions: Answer N/A if none are stored.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Provide or restock spill kits

questions.title: Are up-to-date Safety Data Sheets available for hazardous products on site?
questions.instructions: WHMIS 2015 / Hazardous Products Regulations.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Update Safety Data Sheets for products on site

questions.title: Is there a spill reporting procedure, including when to notify the provincial environment ministry?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Write a spill response and reporting procedure

questions.title: Is there an emergency kit with the plan, contact lists, floor plans, master keys and flashlights, checked within the last 6 months?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Assemble or restock the emergency kit

questions.title: Do wardens have identification (vests or hats), flashlights and a means to communicate (radios or phones)?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Supply warden vests, flashlights and radios

questions.title: Are restoration, emergency repair and security contractors pre-arranged (agreements or approved vendor list)?
questions.instructions: CSA Z1600 continuity planning.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Set up emergency service agreements with restoration and repair contractors

questions.title: Are critical building records (drawings, as-builts, leases, contacts) backed up off site or online?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Back up critical building records off site

questions.title: Is there a post-incident review procedure to record what happened and the follow-up actions?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Add a post-incident review procedure

questions.title: Assessors
